description: Live monitoring dashboard for the VISTA C++ sensor-processing application. Data is received through Grafana Live channels published by grafana_bridge.

panels.title: Live Point Cloud, Room Map and Ground Validation
Live Point Cloud - Sensor Frame
panels.description: Sensor-coordinate XYZ with floor retained. Independent finite/range/voxel filters feed WebSocket :8765; live rendering continues while LIO initializes, degrades or loses localization. Ground plane overlays are intentionally absent here. World mapping uses accepted poses only on :8766.

panels.title: Room Map - Out-of-Core LOD
panels.description: Complete geometry is stored in disk tiles and exported to PCD, with no total voxel-count cap. Plugin 1.1.0 requests camera-dependent octree LOD; maxPoints is a rendering budget, not the total map size. Zoom/pan to retrieve more detail. Building supports measured free-space cleanup; frozen/loaded references remain unchanged.

panels.title: Localization State
panels.description: TRACKING means a fresh accepted pose. DEGRADED can mean stale processing, not necessarily missing IMU. LOST holds the map and preserves the root fault reason; clock/coverage faults require restart.

panels.title: Localization Pose and Quality
panels.description: Only a valid LiDAR-corrected pose feeds the Room Map. On missing IMU, timing faults or rejected localization the map is held, while sensor-frame live point cloud continues. Reason distinguishes clock reset, source changes, missing temporal coverage and stale processing.

panels.title: Ground Validation
panels.description: Ground validation history, one row per sample, newest first. LiDAR and ground mode identify the source. Ground State is shown separately. History is limited to the current Grafana Live buffer, not persistent storage.

panels.title: Room Map State
panels.description: EMPTY: no confirmed points yet. BUILDING: measured hits/free-space rays update geometry. FROZEN: no updates. LOADED: read-only reference. DISABLED: mapping off. LOAD ERROR: invalid/missing file. STORAGE ERROR: disk/cache failure; live capture continues.

panels.title: Room Map Build and Free Space
panels.description: Confirmed/candidate geometry, active build time, input drops and free-space ray counters over time, newest first. Keeps 60 seconds of Grafana Live history (buffer is milliseconds), with the newest sample first. This browser buffer is not persistent storage.

panels.title: Room Map Cache and Operation Timing
panels.description: RAM/disk cache and operation timing history, newest first. RAM Voxel Budget limits the resident cache, not the total map. Keeps 60 seconds of Grafana Live history (buffer is milliseconds), with the newest sample first. This browser buffer is not persistent storage.

panels.title: Room Map I/O and Counters
panels.description: Integration/query/cache and disk/LOD I/O counter history, including cumulative I/O durations, newest first. Keeps 60 seconds of Grafana Live history (buffer is milliseconds), with the newest sample first. This browser buffer is not persistent storage.

panels.title: Room Map Modes and Free-Space Clearing

options.content:
**GrafanaEnabled controls Grafana Live and both WebSocket workers.** Live uses `ws://127.0.0.1:8765`; camera-dependent map LOD uses `ws://127.0.0.1:8766`.

**BUILD:** `RoomMapEnabled: 1`, `RoomMapLoadExisting: 0`. World-coordinate measured hits confirm voxels. Rays clear old geometry only after repeated free observations; occluded geometry behind a measured hit is preserved. Defaults: 5 cm voxels, 3 hit windows, 5 free windows, 100 ms windows, up to 256 rays/window, ray range 30 m, surface margin at least one voxel diagonal. Rays are sampled: clearing may take longer than five windows. No-return/missing frames never clear confirmed map points.

**FROZEN:** `RoomMapFreezeAfterSeconds: 30` stops both fusion and clearing after active acquisition. Use `0` to keep updating during the building session. A person who remains visible may enter the map; this is not detection/tracking.

**LOAD:** `RoomMapLoadExisting: 1` loads `RoomMapFile` as a read-only reference, never subscribes to live geometry and never overwrites that file. A missing/invalid file produces LOAD ERROR, not automatic rebuilding. DISABLED/LOAD ERROR can still have a connected WebSocket carrying zero-point snapshots.

Every building session automatically saves a snapshot on freeze/clean shutdown; there is no save toggle. No-data startup preserves an older snapshot. Build mode ignores RoomMapFile and uses local session-start time for `Repo/data/maps/RoomMap_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.pcd`; collisions add _1, _2, etc. Freeze and shutdown update the same session file. LOAD mode requires RoomMapFile to name the exact existing PCD; an empty value is LOAD ERROR. Change configuration and restart to rebuild; there is no runtime control TXT file. Keep the same LiDAR position and mounting. Update the installed plugin to 1.1.0 for camera-dependent room-map LOD. RoomMapMaxVoxels is removed: RoomMapCacheMaxVoxels (250000) and RoomMapCacheMaxTiles (128) bound the RAM tile cache, not total map geometry. RoomMapTileSizeMeters (2.0) sets spatial tile size; RoomMapLodPointsPerNode (128) controls octree sampling. All confirmed geometry remains on disk and is streamed to the session PCD. RoomMapWebSocketMaxPoints and panel maxPoints bound one visible LOD view, not storage. Zoom/pan requests different detail. Disk/cache metrics and STORAGE ERROR expose storage problems; physical disk/RAM/GPU limits still apply.

The default room-map render budget is now 100000 points per view, without limiting stored map geometry. Camera disk queries do not flush live RAM or hold the mapper update mutex. File replacement and disk queries still share a separate disk lock, so slow storage can still delay an eviction/checkpoint. Room Map Performance Diagnostics separates integration, checkpoint, view query and lock waiting. Complete PCD export remains in mapping on freeze/clean shutdown; no extra logger worker is added.

RoomMapPublishIntervalMilliseconds is the single changed-map tile/LOD checkpoint and publication cadence. A revision is announced only after its checkpoint succeeds, and port 8766 sends it without a second timer. Unchanged heartbeats do not resend geometry; changing the camera or reconnecting still requests a view. This timer does not export the entire PCD: PCD export remains on freeze/clean shutdown. Repeated same-map camera requests are bounded by this same interval.

panels.title: LiDAR Online
panels.description: Live sensor point-cloud stream, independent of localization. Counts include the floor after finite/range/voxel filtering. Localization quality is shown separately.

panels.title: IMU Online
panels.description: Latest IMU state published by the LiDAR decode worker.

panels.title: Point Cloud History
panels.description: Live sensor point-cloud stream, independent of localization. Counts include the floor after finite/range/voxel filtering. Localization quality is shown separately.

panels.title: Message Rate and Data Age
panels.description: Live sensor point-cloud stream, independent of localization. Counts include the floor after finite/range/voxel filtering. Localization quality is shown separately.

panels.title: Worker Health
panels.description: One latest row per worker from the stable worker_health_rows channel. Worker names are ordinary string values, not numeric-series labels. STT starts at 1, followed by Worker, Failed, Priority, Running and uptime in Seconds. Internal timestamps select newest values and are not displayed. Rebuild/restart vista_edge and re-import this dashboard together after updating.

panels.title: Pipeline History
panels.description: Raw input message rate, queue fills and bridge input drops. Processed Message Rate and Point Cloud Data Age appear only in the LiDAR and IMU section; duplicate processed rate and similar age/latency fields are omitted here.

panels.title: Grafana Bridge Health
panels.description: Grafana delivery and retry history: totals, HTTP status, successful push age and subscribed topics, newest first. Keeps 60 seconds of Grafana Live history (buffer is milliseconds), with the newest sample first. This browser buffer is not persistent storage.

panels.title: Radar Targets
panels.description: Reserved for the future radar worker.

panels.title: Detected Objects
panels.description: Reserved for the future detection worker.

panels.title: Active Tracks
panels.description: Reserved for the future tracking worker.

panels.title: Maximum Object Speed
panels.description: Reserved for the future tracking worker.

options.content:
Operational summaries use Grafana Live under the configured namespace (vista). The 3D views connect to the live point cloud at ws://127.0.0.1:8765 and the room map at ws://127.0.0.1:8766. Change those URLs if the browser and VISTA run on different machines.

Each dashboard metric has one primary display. Room-map cache occupancy, map input drops and mapping I/O timings are separate from host resources and Grafana bridge input drops. Raw Message Rate counts raw packets; Processed Message Rate counts independent cleaned sensor messages (including floor), not localization successes or necessarily hardware scans. Live sensor XYZ continues on LIO failure; world mapping is held until a fresh valid pose is available. World ground diagnostics are separate and are not overlaid on sensor-frame live geometry. Ground Validation, Room Map Build and Free Space, Room Map Cache and Operation Timing, Room Map I/O and Counters, and Grafana Bridge Health show buffered Live history with newest rows first. Worker Health alone shows one latest row per worker. Live buffers are not persistent history storage. The bridge sends only fields consumed by this dashboard; XYZ geometry uses the separate WebSockets.

The 3D plugin has its own point/frame and ground-summary overlay. This overlay is built into the plugin and cannot currently be hidden through dashboard JSON. It does not create an additional Grafana Live query.
